title: Fox's interview with Edgar Mitchell at his Florida home

tellings.quote: yes there have been ET visitation

plain: The Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell told the filmmaker and UFO investigator James Fox, in an interview at Mitchell's home in Florida, that "yes there have been ET visitation," meaning visits by extraterrestrials. Fox tells Michels this as the man who sat down with him. Coming from a man who walked on the Moon, it would mean the claim of alien visits has backing from a credible insider.
